title: Contents Packout & Storage — How the Customer's Share Is Figured
content:
**Calculation clause.** The standard customer's share is the storage and declared-value coverage lines on the job billed to customer, plus the card surcharge lines on the job, less the customer payments posted to the job net of the refunds returned from them, rounded to the cent, half up, and never below zero.

This Contents Packout & Storage clause fixes the customer's share paid by the customer on an insurance-funded Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job.

## Quantities read from the job

| Quantity | What it is |
|---|---|
| Lines billed to customer | every storage line and every declared-value coverage line on the job whose bill-to is the customer |
| Card surcharge lines | every credit card surcharge line on the job |
| Customer payments, net | every customer payment posted to the job, less every refund returned from those payments |

## Assembly of the payment amount

The payment amount is found by adding to the standard customer's share, before its rounding and before its floor at zero, every amount the share carries, and rounding that total once to the cent, half up, never below zero. Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added before rounding, so that a figure lying on a half cent always rounds up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Lines billed to customer | Card surcharge lines | Payments posted | Refunds returned | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 420.00 | 6.30 | 200.00 | 0.00 | 226.30 |
| 420.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 | 30.00 | 420.00 less 470.00 is negative; never below zero, so 0.00 |
| 315.555 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | rounded half up, 315.56 |
